provenance.note: Every row of public.organizations, read on 2026-08-21. Both the name and the slug are recorded on purpose: they differ only by one character, and mistaking one for the other is what made the archive refuse 100% of production.
provenance.trap: name is 'trypennie.com' with a DOT. slug is 'trypennie-com' with a HYPHEN. The archive compares against organization.slug, and EXPECTED_ORGANIZATION_SLUG held the name, so every execution was refused as belonging to the wrong tenant. A constant named for one column and populated from another is invisible to every reader, because both values look right (L176).
